name: Vapi
summary: Developer platform for building, testing and deploying voice AI agents, billed per minute.
description: Vapi is a platform for developers building voice agents for use cases such as customer support, lead qualification and appointment scheduling. It orchestrates transcription, language models and voice synthesis from providers such as Deepgram, OpenAI and ElevenLabs. Users start free and pay per minute of calls; the pricing calculator shows component rates per minute for each provider. Developers can choose their own transcriber, model and voice provider for each agent.

howToUse.title: Open Vapi
howToUse.description: Open Vapi and start free as a developer building voice agents.

howToUse.title: Choose the call task
howToUse.description: Set the agent up for customer support, lead qualification, or appointment scheduling.

howToUse.title: Pick transcriber, model, and voice
howToUse.description: For that agent, choose your own transcriber, model, and voice. Providers such as Deepgram, OpenAI, and ElevenLabs cover transcription, the language model, and synthesis, and Vapi orchestrates them.

howToUse.title: Read the per-minute rate
howToUse.description: Open the pricing calculator and read the per-minute component rates, since calls are billed per minute.

features_fr: Plateforme de développement pour créer, tester et déployer des agents d'IA vocale, facturés à la minute.
Vapi est une plateforme permettant aux développeurs de créer des agents vocaux pour des cas d'utilisation tels que le support client, la qualification des leads et la prise de rendez-vous.
Il orchestre la transcription, les modèles linguistiques et la synthèse vocale de fournisseurs tels que Deepgram, OpenAI et ElevenLabs.
Les utilisateurs démarrent gratuitement et paient à la minute d'appels ; le calculateur de prix affiche les tarifs des composants par minute pour chaque fournisseur.
